decision: R1240/R1241 retain both differences. The standard packed painter accepts a real 640x480 frame, clamps to both the destination DIB and remaining plane bytes with the current stride, and rejects an empty request before its original do/while loop. The original height bound rejects a supported frame. Removing the clip instead loses the visible intersection at the lower right. No extra renderer, buffering or error handling required.
